reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding). Gate 2 skipped (no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json). Gate 3 passed (src/lib/actions/ is explicitly in scope). Spec deviation confirmed: six exported Server Actions (toggleAdminStatus, deleteMember, updateMemberTeams, updateStatusesForNewAcademicYear, deleteTeam, updateTeamLeaders) perform DB mutations without Zod safeParse, violating the stated pre-condition property. Attack path requires prior admin account compromise (e.g., Discord OAuth session hijack), making the path uncertain; Supabase parameterized queries further limit direct injection impact, so CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL rather than CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY. Medium severity retained: bulk status corruption is meaningful but bounded to admin-compromise scenarios with no evidence of RCE or exfiltration.
